paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng khangthu a sim in a-om ua; huan, ngai in, Israel leh Judah Kumpipate Laibu ah gelh in a-om uhi: atatlekna ziak un Babulon lam ah sal a pimang in a-om uh.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan Hong Kik Nawnte
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

paite: Amau tante akhopite ua teng masapente bel, Israel, siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite ahi uhi.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

paite: Jerusalem ah Judah tate, Benjamin tate, Ephraim leh Manasseh tate ateng uhi.
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

paite: Ammihud tapa Uthai, Omri tapa, Imri tapa, Bani tapa, Perez tapate ah Judah tapa.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

paite: Shilon mite; Asaiah piang masapen leh atapate.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

paite: Zerah tapate ah; Jeuel, a-unaute, zaguk-le-sawmkua ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

paite: Benjamin tapate ah; Meshullam tapa Sallu, Hodaviah tapa, Hassenuah tapa;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

paite: Huan Jeroham tapa Ibneiah, Uzzi tapa Elah, Mikri tapa, Shephatiah tapa Meshallum, Reuel tapa, Ibnijah tapa.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

paite: A-unaute uh, akhangte uh dungzui in, zakua sawmnga-le-guk ahi uh. Hiai mite tengteng apipute uh inkote dungzui a alupente ahi uhi.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

paite: Huan siampute ah: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib; Jachin;
heading: Jerusalem A Teng Siampute
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

paite: Hilkiah tapa Azariah, Meshullam tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawmpa;
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

paite: Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa, Maasai Adiel tapa, Jahzerah tapa, Meshullam tapa, Meshillemit tapa, Immer tapa;
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

paite: A-unaute uh, apipute uh lupente, sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmguk; Pathian inn a nasepna thilhihna ding a mihithei mahmahte ahi uh.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

paite: Huan Levi mite ah: Hashub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Merari tapate ah;
heading: Jerusalem A Teng Levite
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

paite: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zikri tapa, Asaph tapa;
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

paite: Shemaiah tapa Obadiah, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa, Asa tapa Berekiah, Elkanah tapa, Netophah mite khuate a tengte.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

paite: Huan kongkhak ngak mite; Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, a-unaute uh, Shallum bel amakaipen ahi.
heading: Tempul Vengtu Jerusalem A Tengte
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

paite: Kumpipa kongpi suahlam pang ngak sek: Levi tate puanin a dia kongkhak ngak mite ahi uhi.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

paite: Kore tapa Shallum, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa, a-unaute, apa inkote a, Korah mite, nasepna thilhihna a heutu ahi ua, biakbuk kongpite ngak mite: apipute uh TOUPA puanin tung a heutu, biakbuk lutna ngak mite ahi uhi.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

paite: Eleazar tapa Phinehas hun paisa ah amaute tung a vaihawmpa ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.

paite: Meshelemiah tapa Zekariah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ngakpa ahi.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Hiaite tengteng kongpite kongkhak ngak mite hi ding a telte zanih sawm-le-nih ahi uh. Hiaite akhuate ua khangthu a simte ahi ua, asep ding uh bawlsa a David leh zawlnei Samuel in ahihkipsate ahi uhi.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

paite: Huchi in amau leh atapate un TOUPA' inn kongpite, adandan in, biakbuk inn nangawn in akem uhi.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

paite: Apang lite ah, suahlam, tumlam, mallam, simlam ah kongkhak ngak mite a-om uhi.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

paite: A-unaute uh, akallak lak in ni sagih nite teng in amau kiang a om ding in ahong pai zel ding uh ahi:
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

paite: Kongkhak ngakpipen lite lah, Levi mite, sep ding sehsa a om ahi ua, Pathian insung a dantante leh sumkoihnate tung ah heutu ahi uhi.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

paite: Huai lai a thupiak amau tung a a-om ziak in, Pathian inn kimvel ah agiak ua, zingsang teng in huai hon ding amau nasep ahi.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

paite: Huan alak ua kuate hiam in nasepna tui-um belsuante akem ua; alaklut uleh alakkhiak teng un aphazah asim gige uhi.
heading: Levi Dangte
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

paite: Alak ua khenkhatte vante, mun siangthoupen tui-um belsuan tangbuang nelte, uainte, sathaute begaw leh gimnamtuite kem ding a seh ahi uhi.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

paite: Siampute tapate lak a akhente gimnamtuite toh hel in abawl uh.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

paite: Mattithiah, Levi mite, Korah mi Shallum ta masapen lak a khat in belliangneite kan thilte tung a nasepna sehsa anei hi.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

paite: A-unaute uh lak a akhen, Sabbathte a bawl ding in, Kohath mite tapate'n tanghou akem uhi.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

paite: Hiaite lasa mite ahi ua, Levi mite inkote pipute inkuan a lupente, dantante sung ah ateng ua, sun leh zan in anasepna ua zat in a-om ua, nasepna dangte a kipan a-awl uhi.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

paite: Akhang pumpite uah, hiaite Levi mite pipute inkuan makaipente ahi uh, amakaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, Jehiel, azi min Maakah:
heading: Kumpipa Saul Suangtute Leh Amah Suante / (1 Kro 8.29-38)
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

paite: Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab;
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

paite: Gedor, Ahio, Zekariah, Mikloth.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

paite: Huan Mikloth in Shimeam asuang a, huchi in amau leng a-unaute uh toh Jerusalem ah, a-unaute uh zawn ah ateng uhi.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

paite: Ner in Kish asuang a; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki- shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

paite: Jonathan tapa bel Merib-baal ahi; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

paite: Huan Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea leh Ahaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

paite: Ahaz in Jarah asuang; Jara in Alameth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang hi; Zimri in Moza asuang hi.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

paite: Moza in Binea asuang; Rephaiah atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa;
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

paite: Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan: hiaite Azel tapate ahi uh.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
